TestRADIUSAuthNASIPAddress reads Code 1 and the exact configured IPv4 address from the captured subscriber request. TestRFC2865AccessRequestNamesTheNASWithNoIdentityConfigured sets neither identity leaf and still requires a nonempty NAS-Identifier with no invented address. The only subscriber fixture change is the canonical ID required before provider dispatch; packet and assertion inputs are unchanged.
